title: Balik Gawai
subject: a grandmother at the longhouse stairs counting every returning grandchild for Gawai
caption: Bornean ethno-rock driven by a gong ensemble, sung in Malay. Interlocking agung, tawak and bebandil gongs and gendang drums leading the rhythm, with a rock drum kit, distorted electric guitar and electric bass supporting underneath rather than leading, sape appearing only briefly as colour. Big festival-stage sound with the gongs forward and resonant and a wide crowd-like reverb. Male lead voice, open and projecting, answered by group festival chants and shouts on the chorus. 124 BPM, A minor pentatonic. Everyone counted home. No synth, no programmed drums, no sape-led folk arrangement, no ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - interlocking gongs, drum kit enters]

[Verse 1]
Enam jam jalan, dua jam bot, rumah panjang hujung sungai
Tiga puluh pintu, satu ruai, semua orang balik serentak
Nenek tunggu di tangga, dia kira kami seorang-seorang
Dia kira sampai habis, baru dia masuk ke dalam

[Chorus - festival chant]
Balik Gawai, ha
Gong berbunyi, semua pintu terbuka
Kau kerja di bandar, kau kerja di laut, tak penting
Malam ni kau anak rumah panjang lagi

[Verse 2]
Sepupu aku dah jadi doktor, sepupu aku dah jadi bapa
Kami duduk atas tikar yang sama macam masa kecil
Nenek hulur tuak, aku tolak, dia ketawa
Dia hulur lagi, aku ambil, sebab ni Gawai

[Chorus - festival chant]
Balik Gawai, ha
Gong berbunyi, semua pintu terbuka
Kau kerja di bandar, kau kerja di laut, tak penting
Malam ni dan esok, kau anak rumah panjang lagi

[Outro - gongs alone]
Bot pagi Isnin
Nenek kira lagi, kali ni kami pergi
